notes: CoreWeave 8-K: closing of 144A offering of $2,587,500,000 1.75% Convertible Senior Notes due Dec 1, 2031, including full exercise of the $337,500,000 initial purchasers' option (base deal $2.25bn). Initial conversion price ~$107.80/share (9.2764 shares per $1,000). Existing 9.250% 2030 and 9.000% 2031 senior notes are mentioned only as guarantor reference (not new). Capped calls (~$340.0m cost) are not debt.
